order_raw:
Looking at this case: the patient is having repeated shock-like jerks while in bed, is NOT conscious during them, but crucially has NO post-ictal state, NO tongue biting, NO incontinence, and NO injury. This pattern strongly suggests myoclonus rather than epileptic seizures. I need to determine the cause.
